summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst after Utilities; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests per spec). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests, black, and flake8 are unverified; only line lengths (all under 120) were checked by reading. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; json.JSONDecodeError propagates unchanged; empty lists are accepted for image/label paths.
